# Complete UI control catalogue

905 JSX control declarations across 92 TSX files. A generated/repeated control is one declaration instantiated for its data collection. Dynamic collections and conditional expressions are preserved below and in frontend.json; a static scan cannot enumerate future guests, gifts or administrator-created options. Shared controls are specified once and referenced by route composition.

Native field constraints and React bindings are source facts. A missing HTML required/min/max attribute is not a promise that the API accepts the omission. Type coercion, paise conversion, authorization and DB constraints remain server responsibilities. Unresolved semantic mappings are not guessed; the binding, component requests, API records and DB catalogue provide the traceability chain.
